acceptanceCriteria.text: Gathering tooltips/cards show bounded, time-derived resource estimates and overall progress based on server data.
Travel/return/missing data are handled without invented gathering rates; internal squad/mine IDs are hidden from gathering presentation.
Relevant regression checks and versioned build pass and changes committed.

checkpointPayload.description: Derive collected resource estimates and overall progress from authoritative gathering timers/quantities, share calculations across march tooltips and gathering information cards, and hide technical squad/mine IDs from user-facing gathering UI.
checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: 1. Inspect gathering captures, normalization and UI consumers; establish timer units, phase boundaries and quantity/rate semantics. 2. Add shared guarded estimates/progress and integrate into tooltips/cards while retaining IDs internally for dispatch/recall. 3. Test real-shaped records, stage transitions/missing data and UI, document evidence, version/build and commit.
